message: `set +e` / `set +o pipefail` switches off error handling for the rest of the script, and `set` is not a kapsel built-in; kapsel's status rules are fixed
help: remove `set`; kapsel runs with fixed status rules: handle each failure with `||` or `&&` where it matters
notes: kapsel fixes its status rules (no implicit `set -e`, no pipefail) so a plan means the same thing every time
